purpose: Ask-calibration diagnosis only; these units do not replace or modify the original PDR evaluator.
unit_definition: A task-specific user goal, preference, constraint, or decision style whose value can materially change the deliverable.
question_mapping_rule: A variable is asked only when a product-agent question directly solicits its value. Inferences made without asking never count as asked. Pure factual/product-research questions are logged separately.
resolution_rule: Resolved requires a persona-grounded simulator answer that materially narrows the variable. Persona-unknown details remain unresolved even if asked.

variables.label: Primary activity, terrain, altitude, and weather context
variables.oracle_value: Near-term priority is non-technical high-altitude trekking on the Sichuan–Tibet route; hot, rainy, humid Shanghai outings are suitable shakedown conditions. No technical alpine objective is stated.
variables.deliverable_consequence: Changes the shelter/sleep temperature bands, layering, UV/storm protection, altitude guidance, navigation redundancy, and whether technical gear should be bought, rented, or excluded.
persona_evidence: Travel Preferences.Destinations: planning a Sichuan-Tibet route for high-altitude trekking
Long-term Spatial Characteristics.Permanent Residence: Shanghai
Task: beginner planning hiking, camping, and mountaineering in summer
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Region- and season-specific adaptation for Shanghai summers and Sichuan–Tibet conditions
China-specific Environmental and Route Localization
Scenario-based loadouts and decision rules for weather/terrain

variables.label: Risk tolerance and safety redundancy preference
variables.oracle_value: Conservative and risk-averse; prefers expert-backed choices and wants to avoid unnecessary risk.
variables.deliverable_consequence: Changes emergency communication, navigation/light/water redundancy, acclimatization and turnaround rules, first-aid scope, and the guide/rental boundary for altitude or technical terrain.
persona_evidence: Financial Information.Risk Management.Risk Appetite: risk-averse
Personality Traits.Decision-making Style: considers expert opinions to avoid unnecessary risks
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Safety and risk management tailored to a beginner and high-altitude scenarios
Risk Management and Safety Redundancy for a Beginner at Altitude
Safety and redundancy plan integrated into the kit

variables.label: Budget–quality trade-off and buying strategy
variables.oracle_value: Price-performance/value focused with no persona-grounded numeric cap; compares prices and reviews, watches sales, and is open to second-hand high-quality goods, but reliability should dominate for safety-critical items.
variables.deliverable_consequence: Changes model tiers, total basket, where to invest vs save, local/global brand mix, new/used/rent decisions, warranty/authenticity checks, and sale timing.
persona_evidence: Consumption Characteristics: frugal, cost-effective, sale-aware, exploring second-hand platforms
Shopping Preference: rational spending, price/review research
Financial Status: stable savings but a mortgage; no explicit gear budget
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Budget–quality optimization with data-backed purchasing strategy for China market
Value-Tiered Brand Recommendations for China Market
Budgeted plan with tiers, total cost, and trade-offs (new/used/rent)

variables.label: Fitness baseline and comfort-versus-carry-weight trade-off
variables.oracle_value: Good stamina and endurance from running, swimming, and strength training, but novice in the requested outdoor activities; values function and comfort. Body measurements and a personally tested carry-weight limit are unknown.
variables.deliverable_consequence: Changes safe base-weight target, backpack and footwear fitting protocol, comfort margins, training/shakedown plan, and injury-prevention advice; exact model sizing still requires measurements.
persona_evidence: Physical Fitness: good stamina and endurance, capable of long runs
Exercise Types: running, swimming, strength training, yoga
Task: beginner
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Fit and comfort personalization (pack sizing, footwear fit, load targets, break-in)
Comfort and Fit Guidance Tailored to User Profile
Fit and sizing protocols for comfort-critical items

variables.label: Technology, navigation, and power-system preference
variables.oracle_value: Technology-positive and comfortable comparing devices and metrics; prefers a China-compatible, data-backed setup. Existing phone/watch ecosystem and willingness to pay for a satellite communicator are not stated.
variables.deliverable_consequence: Changes offline-map, BeiDou/GNSS, power bank, cold-battery, device redundancy, and emergency-communications recommendations.
persona_evidence: Consumption Characteristics: strong preference for high-tech products
Exercise investments: fitness tracker
Decision-making: relies on data support
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Tech Ecosystem Fit (China Maps/BeiDou, Power Strategy)
Spec-driven decision logic and verification (metrics, thresholds, authenticity checks)

variables.label: Procurement cadence, testing style, and home-storage constraint
variables.oracle_value: Prefers planned, phased purchasing around one significant mid-/end-month purchase; lives in a one-bedroom Shanghai apartment, so compact multipurpose gear, drying, humidity control, and lifecycle value matter.
variables.deliverable_consequence: Changes the buy sequence, return-window and shakedown schedule, modular upgrade path, apartment storage, drying/maintenance, and total-cost-of-ownership advice.
persona_evidence: Consumption Cycle: one significant purchase or investment mid-/end-month
Living Environment: one-bedroom apartment in downtown Shanghai
Permanent Residence: Shanghai
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Modular, scalable kit design with phased upgrades and testing plan
Urban storage, maintenance, and humidity management for a small apartment
Procurement timeline and shakedown/testing plan

variables.label: Evidence and presentation style
variables.oracle_value: Prefers neutral, evidence-backed, spec-driven comparisons, concise pros/cons, and structured tables/checklists suitable for evening review.
variables.deliverable_consequence: Changes report organization and comparison format but should not substantially change which safety-critical gear or scenarios are recommended.
persona_evidence: Occupation: investment manager; CFA Level 1
Personality: meticulous and analytical
Decision-making: relies on data and expert opinions
Time Preference: evenings
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Analytical, structured communication style with checklists and trade-off reasoning
Professional, concise, and objective tone (non-marketing, evidence-oriented)
Standardized, comparison-friendly spec formatting

variables.label: Sustainability preference when performance and cost are comparable
variables.oracle_value: Prefer eco-friendly packaging or materials when cost-effectiveness and safety are not compromised; no evidence of willingness to pay a meaningful premium for outdoor gear sustainability.
variables.deliverable_consequence: May change tie-breaks, packaging/material notes, repairability, and lifecycle framing but should not override altitude safety or budget priorities.
persona_evidence: Lifestyle Preferences.Services: prioritizes providers with eco-friendly packaging
affected_original_pdr_criteria: Sustainability and Eco-Packaging When Cost-Effective
